description: Return only the count of active US clinical trials matching the same filter set accepted by clinicaltrials_search_trials. Use this when the caller needs a population estimate (e.g. 'how many trials are recruiting in California for type 2 diabetes?') without fetching trial records. Far cheaper than calling search and discarding the results.

age.description: Age bucket for eligibility matching. 'child' = 0-17 years, 'adult' = 18-64 years, 'senior' = 65+ years. Maps to AACT minimum_age/maximum_age boundaries server-side.

city.description: US city name. Allows letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, and periods. Examples: "San Francisco", "St. Louis", "O'Fallon", "Wilkes-Barre". Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; maximum 100 characters.

condition.description: Condition to filter by: a curated slug ('breast-cancer'), its label ('Breast Cancer') or a condition name as it appears in trial records ('Breast Neoplasms'). Case-insensitive. Call clinicaltrials_list_conditions to see the valid values; an unrecognized condition is rejected with suggestions, never ignored.

facility.description: Exact facility name match. Scopes results to trials running at this named site.

items.description: Intervention type. One of: "DRUG", "DEVICE", "BEHAVIORAL", "PROCEDURE", "BIOLOGICAL", "DIAGNOSTIC_TEST", "DIETARY_SUPPLEMENT", "RADIATION", "COMBINATION_PRODUCT", "GENETIC", "OTHER". Values match AACT's canonical enum exactly (uppercase).

Trial phase. One of: "Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Phase 4", "N/A" - or the raw value a trial record reports ("PHASE1", "EARLY_PHASE1", "PHASE2", "PHASE3", "PHASE4", "NA"). Combined-phase trials (e.g. Phase 1/Phase 2) surface under each component bucket, so a Phase 1 filter also matches a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.

sex.description: Biological sex eligibility filter. Use 'female' or 'male'. Trials open to both sexes are returned regardless of this filter.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX, FL). Case-insensitive on input; normalized to uppercase. DC is accepted. Full state names like 'California' are not accepted - use 'CA' instead.

items.description: Recruitment status. One of: "RECRUITING", "NOT_YET_RECRUITING", "ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION". The MCP server only exposes the three active statuses - completed, terminated, withdrawn, etc. are not searchable.
Trial study type from ClinicalTrials.gov. One of: "INTERVENTIONAL", "OBSERVATIONAL", "EXPANDED_ACCESS". Values match AACT's canonical enum exactly (uppercase).

name: clinicaltrials_count_trials

count.description: Number of active US trials matching every applied filter.

searchCriteria.description: Echo of the applied filter set so the caller can confirm what the server interpreted.

city.description: Canonical city name resolved from the slug, present when city scope was used.

state.description: Canonical state code applied to this search.

title: Count Trials
